headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers, Feature names

mono.usage: Technical specs, Data labels, Decorative numbers

colors.theme_strategy: Dark Mode Default (The 'Digital Twin' Aesthetic). High contrast blues against deep slate backgrounds.

layout.grid_system: Use 'Bento' grids (CSS Grid) with gap-4 or gap-6. Avoid standard 12-column bootstrap layouts. Use 'col-span-2' vs 'col-span-1' to create asymmetry.
layout.spacing: Generous. Section padding: py-24 or py-32. Element spacing: gap-8.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-800. Use 'border-l' or 'border-t' only for a technical feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 (Used for sticky nav and modal forms).
visual_enhancers.textures: Background Pattern: A subtle CSS radial-gradient or grid pattern (1px dashed slate-800 lines) to mimic blueprints.

animation.technique: Framer Motion (if available) or CSS Transitions.
animation.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards should 'lift' and 'glow' (border-color change to Cyan).
animation.scroll: Parallax on hero image. Staggered fade-in for list items.

Hero.structure: Split screen or Centered High-Impact. Background: Dark architectural wireframe overlay. Content: Big H1, Subtext, Dual CTA (Schedule Meeting, View Portfolio).

About.structure: Asymmetric Bento Grid. Cell 1: Portrait of Mario (Civil Engineer). Cell 2: Bio/Mission. Cell 3: Key Stat (e.g., '10+ Years Experience').

Services.structure: Grid of 'Tech Cards'. Each card has a mono-spaced ID (01, 02...) and a hover glow effect. Icons: Use Lucide-react (Layers, Box, Ruler, FileCheck).

Portfolio.structure: Masonry or Carousel. High-res visuals of BIM models. Hover reveals project data (Location, Client, Clashes Resolved).

MeetingScheduler.structure: A dedicated section containing an iframe or button for Google Calendar. Style it like a 'Command Center' panel. Glassmorphism background.

Contact.structure: Simple, clean form using Shadcn Input/Textarea. 'Send Message' button must be high-contrast (Accent color).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Install 'lucide-react' if missing. 2. Use the 'Space Grotesk' font from Google Fonts (import in index.css). 3. Create a 'Layout.js' that wraps pages with a Navbar and Footer. 4. Implement the Google Calendar integration as an Embed or a Link button if no embed code is provided (mock the embed for now). 5. ENSURE all text has sufficient contrast against the dark slate backgrounds. 6. Use 'clsx' and 'tailwind-merge' for class handling.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES.design_philosophy: Digital Precision. Every element should feel measured and aligned, like a blueprint.
avoid: Soft rounded corners (use rounded-md or rounded-sm)
